entry.title: New: dsh-quickref
entry.summary: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel. Exact install spec: github:worksassistant/dsh-quickref. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
